57 people came by my house for Christmas. My regular tables were full of food. The folding table was JUST for alcohol. The plastic cups were so we didn't have to clean a bunch of glasses, and when people set their glass down and forget which one was theirs, they go get another glass. You write people's names on the side of the red plastic cup and now people will keep using the same cup all night. At the end of the night, the cups are neatly stacked into each other and easily fit into the recycling bin. The table is easily washed and put away. Given the choice between having one of the rooms in my house be an office/library or a bar/games room, I chose the office/library as I don't party all the time.
